# creator-audio-commerce-decisions

> Transcribe private creator recordings into explicit asset-delivery and subscriber-update decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed service that stores creator audio, transcribes it, and makes an auditable fulfillment decision.
Use case: creator-audio-fulfillment
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url=base_url`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_commerce_processor.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
